model.name: WODA.prod modelled as a UML deployment Node (with real refs + otmux children)
model.description: The WODA.prod server is modelled as a UML deployment-NODE scenario unit with resolvable references to (a) its SSH config, (b) its configured domain, (c) its LetsEncrypt certificate; the current otmux items (session -> window -> pane) appear as CHILDREN of that node root; it renders in the UML diagram in deployment-node style (a 3D node box, not a plain class box).
model.tronQuote: the SERVER modelled as a UML deployment NODE unit with REFERENCES to (a) its SSH config, (b) its configured DOMAIN, (c) its LETSENCRYPT CERTIFICATE, and the CURRENT OTMUX ITEMS (session -> window -> pane) as CHILDREN of that root

acceptanceCriteria.text: A deployment-node unit for WODA.prod exists on disk (UML deployment-Node facet), with its 3 references present.

The 3 refs — SSH config, configured domain, LetsEncrypt certificate — RESOLVE to REAL MEASURED artefacts on WODA.prod AND are SEMANTICALLY CORRECT (each answers the right question for a deployment NODE — the node's OWN inbound service config, not a resolvable-but-wrong outbound client file). NEVER invented/assumed paths (= fabricated identity) and NEVER a real-path-answering-the-wrong-question. Measured referents: DOMAIN=.env LE_DOMAIN/BASE_DOMAIN(prod.wo-da.de); CERT=/etc/letsencrypt/live/prod.wo-da.de/; SSH=/etc/ssh/sshd_config (inbound service) + host identity ~/.ssh/public_keys/root.WODA.prod.public_key — NOT ~/.ssh/config (outbound client).
The current otmux items appear as CHILDREN under the node root in the correct hierarchy: session -> window -> pane.
Renders in the UML diagram in DEPLOYMENT-NODE style (the 3D node-box notation), NOT a plain class box.
INV-T: tree byte-diff == 0 — the node projection is compute-on-read / non-mutating (no write-back to the scenario tree).
@390 mobile REAL-WebKit: the node + its otmux children render legibly.
